notes.title: I will switch from paid to free, hope that more people will play the 2D game
notes.notes:
I'm grateful that more users and YouTubers uploaded the play video than I expected and received a good response.

I will switch from paid to free with the hope that more people will play the 2D game I made.

If many users respond positively after implementing the free policy, we will be encouraged to develop the works to be introduced in the future.

Currently, I have applied to Steam to switch from paid to free, and I am waiting for Steam's permission to switch to free, so that you can enjoy it for free as soon as you get permission to switch to free.

I hope more users will download it and have fun playing.

Lastly, I would like to thank the users who have purchased it for a fee so far, and I would appreciate your generous understanding of the future free-of-charge policy.
